description: This file contains utility functions for processing throughput data, including formatting data rates, calculating data rates from byte counters, formatting timestamps, preparing chart data, and handling units for display purposes.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts bytes per second to a human-readable data rate with appropriate units (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps).

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Computes the data rate in bytes per second based on current and previous byte counters, handling counter resets.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into HH:MM:SS string format.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares datasets and labels for chart visualization from throughput time series data.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the most suitable unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for the Y-axis based on maximum data rate.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts data rates from bytes per second to a specified unit for display consistency.

ctags.name: convertToUnit
ctags.pattern: /^export const convertToUnit = (bytesPerSecond: number, targetUnit: string): number => {$/

ctags.name: current
ctags.pattern: /^  const rxDelta = current.rx >= previous.rx ? current.rx - previous.rx : current.rx;$/

ctags.name: current
